definitions: To openly display one's emotions or feelings rather than hiding them.
To make one's affections or sentiments apparent to others.
examples: She tends to wear her heart on her sleeve, so you always know how she's feeling.
He wears his heart on his sleeve, making him very transparent.
It's easy to tell when she's upset; she wears her heart on her sleeve.
lemma: to wear your heart on your sleeve
synonyms: to lay your cards on the table
source: to wear your heart on your sleeve
